replies.body:
Quick research:

- OpenAI has [short- and long-context pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4), but no corresponding API property. The pricing band is derivable from the model and total input-token count.
- Anthropic exposes actual pricing dimensions: [`cache_control.ttl` and `usage.cache_creation`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#mixing-different-ttls), [`usage.service_tier`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/service-tiers), and [`usage.inference_geo`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/data-residency). We will probably need to record these as additional attributes on the detailed counters. service_tier and geo can go on histograms too since there is one of each per request.

Created issue to follow up - #503

Should we explicitly document how `0` values work for the new counters vs histograms?
